title: fix(app-shell): Studio holds an incomplete field or step as an unsaved edit with a hint, and Publish refuses while one is held (objectui#11786)
body:
Fixes #11786

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

On Studio's Data and Automations pages, the ordinary path through an incomplete field or step no longer passes through a red refusal. Such an edit is held: it stays on screen, unsaved, the inspector says what it needs, and Publish refuses while it is held. A save of a finished draft that is refused keeps objectui#11785's red strip.

- **Data page: Picklist or Radio before an option, Lookup or Master-detail before a target.** Before its autosave sends, the pillar runs the object write guard (`assertObjectMetadataWritable`, the predicate the door itself runs) on the body it would send. When the guard would refuse, the autosave is held (`blocked`): the edit stays dirty and nothing is sent. The field inspector shows "Add at least one option. Changes are saved once the field has one." under the options editor, or "Pick the object to link to. …" under the related-object picker. Where the strip goes, a neutral line names the field by its label: "Not saved yet: the field “Status” needs at least one option. Your changes are kept here and saved once it is filled in." It offers "Show me" when that field's inspector is not the one open. Adding the option or picking the target lets the next autosave go.
- **Automations page: a step added before its required inputs are filled.** Before its autosave sends, the pillar asks `specRequiresField` (`inspectors/flow-required-keys.ts`, reused unchanged) about each top-level step, for every input its inspector shows that the step leaves out. When one is required, the autosave is held. `FlowNodeInspector` shows "Required. Changes are saved once this has a value." under that input's required marker, and the same neutral line names the step and the input ("Title on the step “Notify” needs a value").
- **Publish.** The open pillar reports the clause of its held edit to the surface through a new optional `onHeldEditChange` prop on `DataPillar` and `AutomationsPillar`, set at their three mounts in the surface. The pillar takes the report back on unmount. While an edit is held, the surface's publish shows "Not published: Title on the step “Notify” needs a value, so that change is not saved yet. Finish it, then publish." and publishes nothing.
- **Errors stay for finished work.** A body neither predicate holds is sent exactly as before. Any refusal it draws, such as a server 422 or a transport failure, shows the objectui#11785 strip unchanged. The guard in `@object-ui/data-objectstack` is untouched and still holds the option-less and target-less save on purpose (objectui#11253).

Nothing is added to the package entry: no export, prop, type member or language-pack key. Only `StudioDesignSurface` and its props reach `index.ts`, and neither pillar does. The new strings are rows in the metadata-admin designer's own string table (en and zh), under `engine.studio.held.*` and `designer.field.hint.*`.

## Measured before acting (dispatch Zone 2)

- **H1, which door.** All three cases go through the Studio pillars' `useDraftAutoSave`. The inspector's type switch and the canvas's "add node" each call the pillar's `onPatch`, which raises the dirty flag the hook's timer reads. `ResourceEditPage`'s own autosave is not on any of these paths. The pins hold each case at the hook, and the ablation below shows the hook sending without the hold.
- **H2, Picklist and Lookup never reach the network.** Confirmed. The guard throws inside `MetadataClient.save` before any request: even with the predicate ablated, the transport double records no PUT. The red strip was `doSave`'s catch. **The not-verified part, naming a held edit whose field is not open: my choice** is a neutral line in the strip's place (muted, not destructive), shown whenever an edit is held. It names the field or step, and "Show me" appears only when that input is not the one open. The reason: while an edit is held, the page's save status says nothing. There is no "Saving…", and "Saved HH:MM" is hidden while the buffer is dirty, so the line is the only statement that the change is kept but not sent.
- **H3, the Notify 422.** Measured on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 with `FlowSchema.safeParse`, on the exact draft Studio sends: `buildFlowSkeleton`, plus a Notify added on the edge with the canvas seed `channels: ['inbox'], recipients: []`. The parse reports **one** issue, at `nodes.2.config.title`: "A notify node needs one content source: inline `title` (+ optional `message`), or a `template` reference … Neither was given, so there is nothing to deliver." **An empty `recipients` list is not refused.** The key is required, but an empty list is a value, so the "recipients and title" part of the hypothesis holds only for the title. This is the spec parse, not a live 422: no booted showcase was reachable here, because the sibling objectstack checkout has no install or build. So the hold asks the spec for each input, never a list. A missing `recipients` key is held (pinned). An empty list is not held, a blank `title: ''` is not held (the judge accepts it), and a `template` in place of `title` is not held.
- **H4, Publish with a held edit.** Measured by ablation (run C below): with the surface's check removed, the sheet's publish calls `publishPackageDrafts` while the Notify edit is held. In other words, it publishes the saved drafts without the edit. Now Publish refuses and names the step. The signal crosses from pillar to header through the new optional prop and the three mount lines. No file outside the claim is touched.
- **H5, finished but wrong stays red.** Pinned: a server 422 on a complete Data body shows the red strip naming the field, and no held line. `AutomationsPillar.authorRefusal-11785.test.tsx` (a save refused through the Enabled switch) is unchanged and green.

## Pins

- `metadataError.heldEdit-11786.test.ts` (the two predicates): each "held" case is paired with the judge's own verdict on the same body (the door refuses it, or `FlowSchema` names the key), and each "not held" control with a body that judge accepts. So the hold is never stricter than the contract. Covered: the measured Notify seed held for Title, a missing `recipients` key, an unlabelled step, the guard's order, an unnamed array field (not held, its refusal shows), and zh.
- `DataPillar.heldIncomplete-11786.test.tsx` (real `MetadataClient`, transport double): Picklist sends nothing and shows no red strip, shows the line and the options hint, and one option sends the save and clears both. Lookup does the same with the target hint, and a typed target sends the save. "Show me" reopens a held field after its inspector was closed. Controls: a complete edit autosaves with no line, and a server 422 on a complete body shows the red strip.
- `AutomationsPillar.heldIncomplete-11786.test.tsx` (real `FlowPreview` / `FlowInspector`): a Notify added on the edge sends no draft and shows no red strip. The line names "Title on the step “Notify”", and exactly one hint sits directly under Title. Filling Title sends the save and clears both. "Show me" reopens the step after deselecting it.
- `StudioDesignSurface.heldPublish-11786.test.tsx` (the real surface): with a Notify held, Publish refuses naming it and publishes nothing. Once the step is filled and saved, Publish goes. With nothing held, Publish goes as before.
- Updated, same claims: the Picklist case of `DataPillar.authorRefusal-11785.test.tsx` and both cases of `DataPillar.choiceWithoutOptions-11253.test.tsx` now read the held line, not a refusal strip. objectui#11785's requirements (the field named by its label, no developer text, "Show me" reopens it) and objectui#11253's wire claim (no request carries a choice without options, and one option lets the save go) are asserted unchanged. The guard's sentence with Details is still pinned at the view model, in `metadataError.authorRefusal-11785.test.ts`.

## Ablation (committed implementation, restore proven each leg)

Run on `4996e5a` through `ablation-replace` (anchor hit once, landed on disk, restored), under the shared verify lock:

- **A**, the Data predicate removed from the autosave's `blocked`: `DataPillar.heldIncomplete-11786` 2 failed of 5 (Picklist and Lookup). First failure: "no red strip on the normal path: expected the refusal strip to be null". The guard's strip came back. The "Show me" pin stayed green: it reads the line, which the predicate still feeds, and the no-request half is the guard's own.
- **B**, the flow predicate removed from `blocked`: `AutomationsPillar.heldIncomplete-11786` 2 failed of 2. "a step missing a required input is not sent: expected vi.fn() to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times".
- **C**, the surface's held check in publish disabled: `StudioDesignSurface.heldPublish-11786` 1 failed of 3. "Publish must not go around the held edit: … called 1 times". This is the H4 measurement.
- Each restore: blob `0d81d740590c` equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The final proof after all three legs gave the same result.

## Tests and gates

Final head `ed6cc52` (this branch merged with `main` at `b0aa892`, never rebased), from the worktree root:

- **Build and type-check** (locked): `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2`, 28 of 28 tasks, exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all four new test files.
- **Tests** (locked): `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on the union below, run on `ed6cc52`: **291 files passed, 3110 tests passed and 1 skipped** (a `skipIf` that keys on the installed spec's version and was already there), exit 0.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` in full, plus every app-shell and console test that imports `StudioDesignSurface`, `metadataError`, `ObjectFieldInspector`, `FlowNodeInspector`, `FlowInspector` or the built-in inspector registration, plus the metadata-admin i18n, flow and `ResourceEditPage` suites. The set is derived by `git grep` on this head.
  - **Declared narrowing:** app-shell's full suite is CI's. The derived set covers direct importers of the changed modules, and is blind to a test that reaches them only transitively.
- **ESLint** on the 11 changed source and test files: 0 errors and 27 warnings, every one on a line this branch did not write (by `git blame`). The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Gates**, all exit 0: control-bytes, test-path-roots, changeset-claims, pending-changeset-literals, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-dead-keys (none of the new rows reported), i18n-designer-parity ("Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."), metadata-write-doors ("3 reach assertObjectMetadataWritable"), new-line-citations, spec-symbols, designer-field-key-parity, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, and `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` ("An ordinary pull request").
- **NOT MEASURED: check:eager-closure.** PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it reads a built console. Stand-in: the new imports in `metadataError.ts` (`flow-required-keys.ts`, `flow-node-config.ts`, `@objectstack/spec/automation`) are already in the package entry's eager closure, through `register-builtins.ts` → `inspectors/index.ts` → `FlowInspector` → `FlowNodeInspector`. So no module enters it. `ObjectFieldInspector` imports nothing new beyond more names from a module it already imported.
- **Cost:** `flowHeldEdit` measured about 4 ms per draft change on a flow of 40 complete Notify steps (a shared-box reading, so ratio-only). It runs only while the buffer is dirty. No cache was added.
- **Real browser:** not taken. No booted Studio was reachable (no objectstack install or build in this container), so the pins go through the real pillar components, as objectui#11785's did.

## Acceptance notes

- Two explicit saves still send an incomplete buffer, both outside this card's regions: the Data page's column drag-reorder (`doReorderFields`) and the Automations page's Enabled switch (`toggleEnabled`). Each saves the whole buffer at once. With a held field or step, it draws the guard's or the server's refusal as objectui#11785's red strip, naming it. Read from code; not reproduced in a browser. No one is carrying this.
- Steps nested in a loop, parallel or try/catch region are not checked by the flow predicate. Their refusal shows as the server words it.
- Leaving the Data or Automations page with a held edit discards it without a prompt, as an unsent (refused) edit was discarded before. Only the Access and Interfaces pillars report dirty state to the header's leave-confirm. Not changed here.
- The inline hints also appear where the same inspectors serve the metadata-admin editors. They are worded to hold there too ("Changes are saved once …"), and that page's own save gate is unchanged.
